answer: Sonnet ceremony: each identity stakes 70 credits on the cedar board, files one sonnet in the dune window, 14 lines, one task each. One operator writes a sonnet an hour, so filings share one window; auditors replay the board; a late sonnet, copied lines, or one key on two sonnets burns the bond and exposes a rented-choir ring. 1,000 fakes: 70,000 locked, 44,000 fees = 114,000 vs a 40,000 pool. One honest filing costs 44 and keeps the bond.
